data_dir.description: Base directory for MooseFS metadata and working files.

log_dir.description: Directory where metadata logs are stored. May be same as data_dir.

master_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the MooseFS master server.

master_port.description: Port number used by the MooseFS master server.

listen_port.description: Port on which this metalogger listens for connections from other components.

workers.description: Number of worker threads for handling metadata logging and replication.

master_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for connecting to or receiving data from the master.

reconnect_timeout.description: Delay (in seconds) before attempting to reconnect to the master after disconnection.

persistence.description: Whether to persist metadata logs to disk (recommended for durability).

replicas.description: List of additional metalogger replicas to sync metadata with.

allowed_hosts.description: Optional comma-separated list of allowed master hostnames (empty = allow any host).

master_password.description: Optional password for authenticating with the master (empty = no authentication).

debug.description: Enable verbose logging and diagnostics for troubleshooting.

syslog_min_level.description: Minimum level of messages reported by metalogger; options: ERROR, WARNING, NOTICE, INFO, DEBUG.

syslog_elevate_to.description: Minimum syslog level to elevate lower-priority messages to.

back_logs.description: Number of metadata change log files to keep.

back_meta_keep_previous.description: Number of previous metadata files to keep.

meta_download_freq.description: Metadata download frequency in hours (at most back_logs/2).
